propositions: Nine modules are within 20 LOC of the locked 800-LOC cap and three are exactly at it, making minimal changes unlandable.
Story 343b's gap-5 wiring of provider_provenance through finalize_verdict cannot land because gate_dispatch.py has only 1 line of headroom against the cap.
gate_dispatch.py must be split under 700 LOC along an existing call-graph seam by extracting the plan-review recovery cluster into a new module.
orchestrator.py must be split under 700 LOC by extracting the run-scoped context-assembly cluster.
Extracted modules must stay above the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor and require zero unjustified test edits, using re-import of moved names to preserve monkeypatch seams.
The code-review gate cluster must not be extracted because code_review_enabled is string-monkeypatched at 14 sites and moving it would silently break those patches.
